sentences.pinyin: Jiàoshījié kuài dào le. Xiǎomíng hé Lìli dōu xiǎng gěi lǎoshī sòng yī fèn tèbié de lǐwù. Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ yào zìjǐ zuò yī zhāng kǎpiàn sòng gěi lǎoshī." Lìli shuō: "Zhège bànfǎ hěn hǎo! Wǒ qù huāyuán zhāi yīxiē xīnxian de huā sòng gěi lǎoshī ba!" Nà tiān wǎnshang, Xiǎomíng rènzhēn de zuò kǎpiàn. Tā zài zhǐ shàng huà le yī duǒ dà hóng huā, hái xiě le wǔ gè zì: "Lǎoshī, xièxie nín!" Suīrán tā xiě de yǒudiǎn màn, dànshì xiě de fēicháng zǐxì. Wǎnshang shí diǎn, tā zhōngyú bǎ kǎpiàn zuò hǎo le. Dì-èr tiān zǎoshang, Lìli zài huāyuán lǐ zhāi le wǔ duǒ xīnxian de huā. Huā hěn piàoliang, yě hěn xiāng. Tā xiǎoxīn de bǎ huā dài dào le xuéxiào. Dào le xuéxiào, tāmen bǎ lǐwù sòng gěi le lǎoshī. Xiǎomíng shuō: "Lǎoshī, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ zuò de kǎpiàn, xièxie nín měitiān jiāo wǒmen." Lìli shuō: "Zhèxiē huā shì cóng wǒmen huāyuán lǐ zhāi de, xīwàng nín xǐhuan!" Lǎoshī kàn le kǎpiàn hé huā, yǎnjīng hónghóng de. Tā xiào zhe duì háizimen shuō: "Xièxie nǐmen! Xuésheng shuō de yījù 'xièxie', jiùshì gěi lǎoshī zuì hǎo de lǐwù. Kàndào nǐmen yuèláiyuè nǔlì, lǎoshī xīnlǐ tèbié gāoxìng." Xiǎomíng tīng le lǎoshī de huà, xīnlǐ nuǎnnuǎn de. Tā xiǎng: Lǎoshī duì wǒ zhème hǎo, wǒ yīdìng yào hǎohǎo xuéxí. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, Xiǎomíng xuéxí gèng nǔlì le. Tā shàngkè rènzhēn tīngjiǎng, huíjiā rènzhēn zuò zuòyè. Bàn nián yǐhòu, tā de chéngjì tígāo le hěn duō. Lǎoshī gāoxìng de shuō: "Xiǎomíng, nǐ de chéngjì zhēn bùcuò!" Xiǎomíng xiào zhe shuō: "Zhè dōu shì yīnwèi nín jiāo de hǎo. Lǎoshī, xièxie nín!"
sentences.english: Teachers' Day was approaching. Both Xiaoming and Lili wanted to give a special gift to their teacher. Xiaoming said, "I want to make a card myself to give to the teacher." Lili said, "This is a great idea! I'll go pick some fresh flowers in the garden to give to the teacher!" That evening, Xiaoming made the card earnestly. He drew a big red flower on the paper and wrote five words: "Teacher, thank you!" Although he wrote a bit slowly, he wrote very carefully. At ten o'clock in the evening, he finally finished making the card. The next morning, Lili picked five fresh flowers in the garden. The flowers were very beautiful and also very fragrant. She carefully brought the flowers to school. When they arrived at school, they gave the gifts to the teacher. Xiaoming said, "Teacher, this is a card I made myself. Thank you for teaching us every day." Lili said, "These flowers were picked from our garden, I hope you like them!" The teacher looked at the card and the flowers, her eyes turning red. Smiling, she said to the children, "Thank you! A 'thank you' from a student is the best gift for a teacher. Seeing you working harder and harder makes me especially happy inside." Hearing the teacher's words, Xiaoming felt warmth in his heart. He thought: The teacher is so good to me, I must study hard. From that day on, Xiaoming worked even harder on his studies. He listened attentively in class and did his homework conscientiously at home. Half a year later, his grades improved a lot. The teacher said happily, "Xiaoming, your grades are really great!" Xiaoming said with a smile, "This is all because you teach so well. Teacher, thank you!"
